meaning.en: in the true realm, the field of truth
Brahma approached Narayana
the great, boundless kingdom of being

words.sanskrit: kim tarakam tat no bruhi bhagavan

meaning.en: Lord, tell us what the crossing-syllable is
meaning.hi: हे भगवन्, वह तारक अक्षर हमें बताइए

meaning.en: hold to my own true, blissful, pure abode
meaning.hi: मेरे सत्य-आनंदमय, सात्त्विक धाम की उपासना करो

meaning.en: "I am always the given one"
those who realise this agree, come to know it directly
meaning.hi: इसे जान लेने वाले ऐसा ही मानते हैं

meaning.en: by which they stop being tossed about in the world
meditating on Vishnu in his universe-filling form, on Narayana, on Dattatreya
meaning.hi: विश्वरूपधारी विष्णु, नारायण, दत्तात्रेय का ध्यान करके

meaning.en: speaks the truth
the sound Da is the swan-cry of the self

words.sanskrit: dam iti dirgham tad-bijam nama bija-stham

meaning.en: lengthened, it becomes the seed held within that same seed
meaning.hi: दीर्घ होने पर वह बीज के भीतर बीज बन जाता है

meaning.en: said as one unbroken sound, it becomes the single syllable
that is the very crossing-syllable
this alone is to be worshipped and known: the power that carries one even out of the womb
meaning.hi: यही उपास्य और ज्ञेय है, गर्भ आदि से तारने वाला

meaning.en: its metre is Gayatri
its seer is Sadashiva
its deity is Dattatreya
just as a banyan tree is folded inside its seed, the whole universe is folded inside Datta's seed-syllable
meaning.hi: जैसे बरगद बीज में समाया है, वैसे ही सारा जगत दत्त-बीज में समाया है

meaning.en: this is the explanation of the one syllable

meaning.en: the first syllable is Om
the second is Shreem
the third is Hreem
the fourth is Kleem
the fifth is Gloum
the sixth is Draam
these together make the six syllables
it makes every kind of good fortune grow
meaning.hi: यह सब सम्पदा बढ़ाने वाला है

meaning.en: it brings the direct felt experience of yoga

meaning.hi: छंद गायत्री, ऋषि सदाशिव, देवता दत्तात्रेय

words.sanskrit: om shrim hrim klim glaum dram iti shad-aksharo ayam bhavati

meaning.en: Om Shreem Hreem Kleem Gloum Draam — together these are the six syllables

meaning.en: whether said as Dram or as Draam
"salutations to Dattatreya" — this is the eight-syllable mantra
the name Dattatreya carries the essence of truth, bliss, and awareness
the word salutations is the embodiment of complete joy

words.sanskrit: gayatri chandah sadashiva rishih dattatreyo devata

meaning.en: its metre is Gayatri, its seer is Sadashiva, its deity is Dattatreya
meaning.hi: छंद गायत्री, ऋषि सदाशिव, देवता दत्तात्रेय

meaning.en: the phrase "to Dattatreya" is the peg that fixes the mantra
that same phrase is also the seed
the word salutations is the power

words.sanskrit: om iti prathamam, aam iti dvitiyam, hrim iti tritiyam, krom iti chaturtham

meaning.en: Om first, then Aam, then Hreem, then Krom
"come to me" is then said
meaning.hi: 'एही' — मेरे पास आइए, यह कहा जाता है

words.sanskrit: dattatreya iti svaha iti mantra-rajo ayam dvadasha-aksharah

meaning.en: "Dattatreya, I offer this" completes the twelve-syllable king among mantras
meaning.hi: 'दत्तात्रेय स्वाहा' सहित यह बारह-अक्षर मंत्रराज है

words.sanskrit: jagati chandah sadashiva rishih dattatreyo devata

meaning.en: its metre is Jagati, its seer is Sadashiva, its deity is Dattatreya
meaning.hi: छंद जगती, ऋषि सदाशिव, देवता दत्तात्रेय

meaning.en: Om is its seed
"I offer this" is its power
the word of address is its peg
"Dram" is placed at the heart
"Hreem, Kleem" are placed at the crown of the head
"come to me" is placed at the topknot
"Datta" is placed as armour over the body
"Atreya" is placed at the eyes
"I offer this" is placed as the weapon
whoever knows this becomes one with what it points to
meaning.hi: जो यह जानता है वह तन्मय हो जाता है

meaning.en: now the sixteen-syllable mantra is explained
meaning.hi: अब षोडशाक्षर मंत्र की व्याख्या की जाती है

words.sanskrit: pranam deyam, manam deyam, chakshuh deyam, shrotram deyam

meaning.en: one must be ready to give breath, honour, sight, and hearing to receive it
meaning.hi: प्राण, मान, नेत्र, श्रोत्र देने को तैयार रहना पड़ता है

meaning.en: it severs sixteen heads (layers of ignorance) at once
meaning.hi: यह सोलह सिर काट डालता है

meaning.en: the sixteen-syllable mantra is never to be given carelessly
meaning.hi: षोडशाक्षर मंत्र लापरवाही से नहीं दिया जाता

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: this should be taught only to a devoted disciple of long service and real virtue
meaning.hi: अति सेवा-परायण, गुणवान भक्त शिष्य को ही बताया जाए

meaning.en: the first syllable is Om
the second is Aim
the third is Krom
the fourth is Kleem
the fifth is Kloom

words.sanskrit: hram iti shashtham, hrim iti saptamam, hrum iti ashtamam

meaning.en: the sixth is Hraam, the seventh Hreem, the eighth Hroom
meaning.hi: छठा ह्रां, सातवाँ ह्रीं, आठवाँ ह्रूं

meaning.en: the ninth is Sauh
"to Dattatreya" fills the tenth through fourteenth places
"I offer this" completes it as the sixteenth

words.sanskrit: gayatri chandah sadashiva rishih dattatreyo devata

meaning.en: its metre is Gayatri, its seer is Sadashiva, its deity is Dattatreya
meaning.hi: छंद गायत्री, ऋषि सदाशिव, देवता दत्तात्रेय

meaning.en: Om is its seed, the offering-word is its power
the fourth-case ending of the name is its peg
"Om" is placed at the heart
"Klaam, Kleem, Kloom" are placed at the topknot

meaning.en: "Sauh" is placed as armour
the fourth-case ending is placed at the eyes
"I offer this" is placed as the weapon

words.sanskrit: yo nityam adhiyanah sat-cid-ananda sukhi mokshi bhavati

meaning.en: whoever recites this daily becomes happy in truth-awareness-bliss and liberated
meaning.hi: जो नित्य जप करता है, वह सच्चिदानंद-सुखी मोक्षी हो जाता है

words.sanskrit: sauh iti ante shri-vaishnava ity ucyate

meaning.en: whoever completes it with "Sauh" is called a true devotee of Vishnu
meaning.hi: अंत में 'सौः' सहित जपने वाला श्रीवैष्णव कहलाता है

meaning.en: one who repeats it with attention comes to embody Vishnu himself
meaning.hi: जपने वाला विष्णुरूप हो जाता है

meaning.en: now the Anushtup metre mantra is explained
meaning.hi: अब अनुष्टुप छंद समझाया जाता है

meaning.en: everywhere, the same words of address apply
meaning.hi: सर्वत्र यही संबोधन लागू होते हैं

meaning.en: Dattatreya, remover of sorrow, Krishna, giver of overflowing joy
sky-clad sage, playful as a child, wild as a spirit, ocean of wisdom

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: anushtup chandah sadashiva rishih dattatreyo devata

meaning.en: its metre is Anushtup, its seer is Sadashiva, its deity is Dattatreya
meaning.hi: छंद अनुष्टुप, ऋषि सदाशिव, देवता दत्तात्रेय

meaning.en: "Dattatreya" is placed at the heart
"Hare Krishna" is placed at the crown
"overflowing joy" is placed at the topknot
"the giver, the sage" is placed as armour
"sky-clad" is placed at the eyes
"wild spirit, ocean of wisdom" is placed as the weapon
I have studied this Anushtup hymn myself
meaning.hi: यह अनुष्टुप मैंने स्वयं अध्ययन किया है

meaning.en: even faults carried from a flawed birth fall away
meaning.hi: अब्रह्मजन्म के दोष भी नष्ट हो जाते हैं

meaning.en: whoever helps everyone freely is liberated
whoever knows this reaches the deepest teaching; so ends this part
meaning.hi: जो यह जानता है, वह उपनिषद् तक पहुँचता है

meaning.en: Om is to be recited
Om, salutations to the Lord, to Dattatreya
who is content with mere remembrance
meaning.hi: स्मरणमात्र से संतुष्ट होने वाले को

meaning.en: who removes even the greatest fear
meaning.hi: महाभय का निवारण करने वाले को

meaning.en: who grants deep wisdom
whose very nature is awareness and bliss
who wears the guise of a child, a madman, a wandering spirit
meaning.hi: बाल, उन्मत्त, पिशाच वेष वाले को

meaning.en: the great master of yoga, beyond all rules and roles
who deepens Anasuya's joy, the son of Atri
meaning.hi: अनसूया के आनंद को बढ़ाने वाले, अत्रि-पुत्र को

meaning.en: who grants the fruit of every wish
meaning.hi: सब कामनाओं का फल देने वाले को

meaning.en: to release from the bonds of worldly life, say Hreem
meaning.hi: भवबंधन से मुक्ति हेतु ह्रीं कहें

meaning.en: to receive every kind of wealth, say Krom

meaning.en: to draw toward oneself what is worth having, say Sauh
meaning.hi: साध्य के आकर्षण हेतु सौः कहें

meaning.en: to calm and steady every restless mind, say Shreem
meaning.hi: सब मनों को शांत करने हेतु श्रीं कहें

meaning.en: say Mahom
for long life, say Vashat
to bring a wandering mind under control, say Vaushat twice
meaning.hi: वश में करने हेतु वौषट् दो बार कहें

meaning.en: to draw something close, say Hum twice
meaning.hi: आकर्षण हेतु हुं दो बार कहें

meaning.en: to keep hostility at a distance, say Phat twice
meaning.hi: विद्वेष हेतु फट् दो बार कहें

meaning.en: to clear away what obstructs, say Thath twice
meaning.hi: उच्चाटन हेतु ठठ् दो बार कहें

meaning.en: to hold something steady and unshaken, say Khakh twice
meaning.hi: स्तंभन हेतु खख् दो बार कहें

meaning.en: to remove what harms, say "strike down, strike down; salutations to the whole one"
to nourish and support, say Svaha and "nourish, nourish"
to cut through what other mantras, devices, or hidden forces have bound, say "cut through, cut through"
to turn away misfortune, say "ward off, ward off"
to turn away sickness, say the same
to dissolve sorrow, say "take it away, take it away"
to dissolve poverty, say "drive it out, drive it out"
to nourish the body, say "nourish, nourish"
to bring the mind contentment, say "satisfy, satisfy"
belonging to the one who is the form of every mantra, device, ritual, and fresh unfolding of grace
Om, salutations to Shiva; so ends the Upanishad
meaning.hi: ओं नमः शिवाय, यहाँ उपनिषद् समाप्त होती है

meaning.en: whoever knows this

meaning.en: its metre is Anushtup, its seer is Sadashiva, its deity is Dattatreya
meaning.hi: छंद अनुष्टुप, ऋषि सदाशिव, देवता दत्तात्रेय

words.sanskrit: om iti bijam, svaha iti shaktih, dram iti kilakam

meaning.en: it is as if the Gayatri were recited a hundred thousand times
meaning.hi: मानो गायत्री का लाख जप हुआ हो

meaning.en: it is as if the great Rudra hymn were recited a hundred thousand times
meaning.hi: मानो महारुद्र का लाख जप हुआ हो

meaning.en: it is as if Om alone were recited ten million times
meaning.hi: मानो प्रणव का करोड़ जप हुआ हो

meaning.en: it purifies a hundred generations before and a hundred after
meaning.hi: सौ पूर्वजों और सौ वंशजों को पवित्र करता है

meaning.en: he becomes a purifier of everyone he sits among
he is freed from grave wrongs, even harming a wise teacher
meaning.hi: ब्रह्महत्यादि पातकों से मुक्त होता है

meaning.en: he is freed from the wrong of harming a gentle, defenceless creature
meaning.hi: गोहत्यादि पातकों से मुक्त होता है

meaning.en: through generosity and rightful giving he is cleansed of accumulated wrongdoing
meaning.hi: तुलापुरुष आदि दानों से पवित्र होता है

meaning.en: he is freed from every kind of fault
meaning.hi: समस्त पापों से मुक्त होता है

meaning.en: he is freed from faults to do with what one has eaten or refused
meaning.hi: भक्ष्याभक्ष्य के पापों से मुक्त होता है

meaning.en: he becomes fully accomplished in every mantra and in yoga
meaning.hi: सर्व मंत्र-योग में पारंगत होता है

meaning.en: he becomes, in the truest sense, one who has realised the sacred within
meaning.hi: वही सच्चा ब्राह्मण हो जाता है

meaning.en: he then becomes fit to accept a devoted disciple in turn
meaning.hi: इसलिए वह भक्त शिष्य को स्वीकार करे

meaning.en: he reaches an endless, unbounded fruit
he becomes free while still living
